title: Vulcana
summary: Vulcana is a robed Yama-Titan whose body is composed of molten material and whose hair is made of fire. Gliding through the air with the utmost maneuverability, she is capable of controlling the element of fire. Vulcana is the primary Titan of the explosive Blood Spiral fanatic, Kiel.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Vulcana was invoked by Kiel to take on the Huntik team in Medusa's Cave, but she was stopped and neutralized by Lok Lambert's Dendras. However, when Marduk and the Casterwill Hunters arrived to help Kiel, Dendras was returned to his Amulet leaving Vulcana free to fight. In the heat of battle, Vulcana attacked Powerbonded Baselaird and the battle resulted in both of the two Titans being defeated. [Zhalia's Mission]

Kiel summoned Vulcana outside the Pyramid of the Sun to attack Sophie Casterwill. After defeating Enfluxion, Vulcana created a ring of fire around Sophie and Kiel. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Vulcana was used by Kiel during the Blood Spiral attack on the Fortress of Iron Will. During the battle, she and Kiel watched over the Spiral army from the air before fighting against Dante Vale and Ariel. After defeating Ariel, she carried Kiel to the entrance of the Fortress where she worked alongside Balenpyre to attack Sophie. Vulcana was then defeated by the newly Powerbonded Sorcerel. [The Spiral War]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E38 Vulcana Sophie flames.jpg|thumb|Vulcana uses her hair to create a ring of flames around [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]]]]
Vulcana is capable of controlling fire for her attacks and her assaults range from direct fireballs from her mouth or hands to creating rings of flames around her enemies from her flowing, fiery hair. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}} Vulcana's body is made out of fire so attacking her can be deadly enough to send a [[Titan]] as strong as [[Baselaird]] back to its Amulet. {{Source|Zhalia's Mission}} Her ability to fly through the air at speed means she is capable of dodging attacks and fighting on equal ground with [[Ariel]]. This ability also lets her transport her Seeker by carrying them. {{source|The Spiral War}}
